Steve-O, the Jackass star famous for reckless stunts, joins Joe Rogan for episode 2463 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Now older and sober, Steve-O still performs wild live shows but speaks openly about addiction and recovery. His visits mix cringe comedy with real honesty.

Steve-O tells stories from the Jackass years and the chaos that nearly killed him. He explains how sobriety changed his act and his life without taming his humor. Rogan, an old friend of the crew, draws out both the laughs and the lessons. Fans get the laughing and the cringing in one sitting.
